Buttermilk-brined chicken thigh nuggets in a garlic paprika crust, fried crisp and tossed in chilli salt, with a herby green mayo for dipping. Cut 700g chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and soak in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Mix 200g plain flour with 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika and pepper. Dredge the chicken and fry at 170C for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Toss in salt mixed with a pinch of chilli flakes. Blitz 120g mayo with a handful of parsley, chives and lemon juice for the dip.
Panko crumbed prawns fried golden, with sweet chili sauce and lime

A bowl of mixed berries and cherries tossed with a little honey and mint, with a pot of whipped mascarpone.
M: Spatchcock chicken roasted over potatoes and carrots, glazed with honey
Whole chicken spatchcocked, roasted at 220C for 40 minutes, glazed with honey, garlic and thyme for the last 10. Roast root vegetables.
a big slab of everything, served before the Sarlacc pit

Salt and pepper brisket smoked low until it wobbles, sliced thick with sticky barbecue sauce, tangy slaw, pickles and soft white bread. Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper. Smoke or roast at 120C for about 10 hours until 95C inside, wrapping in baking paper once it reaches 70C. Rest 1 hour. Shred quarter of a cabbage and 1 carrot and toss with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Slice the brisket thick and serve with barbecue sauce, the slaw, dill pickles and white bread.
W: Mixed berry crumble with oats and hazelnuts, vanilla ice cream

Bubbling mixed forest berries under a crunchy oat, hazelnut and brown sugar crumble, served warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Heat the oven to 180C. Toss 750g frozen mixed berries with 80g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 120g plain flour until crumbly, then stir in 60g rolled oats, 50g chopped hazelnuts and 100g brown sugar. Scatter over the berries and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
K: Cold milk blended with pineapple, lime and blue spirulina, no alcohol
Cold milk blended with frozen pineapple, lime and a drop of blue spirulina until smooth.

dishes.make_ahead: Butterfly and crumb the prawns up to 4 hours ahead, laid on a tray in the fridge; fry just before serving

steps.text: Butterfly the prawns.
Dip in flour, then egg, then panko.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C in batches until golden.
Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the haloumi fingers up to 1 day ahead, laid on a tray in the fridge; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into 20 thick fingers and pat dry.
Dip in flour, then egg, then panko.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C in batches until golden.
Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.
Toss the strawberries, blueberries and cherries with some honey and torn mint.
Whip the mascarpone with a spoon of honey until soft.
Serve the fruit in a bowl with the mascarpone alongside.

dishes.make_ahead: Spatchcock the chicken up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; cut the vegetables, roast and glaze on the night

steps.text: Spatchcock the chicken and cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks.
Lay the chicken over the vegetables, season and drizzle with oil.
Roast at 220C.
Warm the honey with the garlic and thyme, brush over and roast until glossy.
Rest and pull apart to share.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the haloumi into slabs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; chop the vegetables and roast on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks and the haloumi into 8 slabs.
Toss the potatoes, carrots and chickpeas with the oil and season.
Roast at 220C for 35 minutes.
Lay the haloumi on top and roast 10 minutes more.
Warm the honey with the garlic and thyme, brush over the haloumi and roast until glossy.
Pile onto a board to share.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Toss the berries with the caster sugar and cornflour in a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour until crumbly, then stir in the oats, hazelnuts and brown sugar.
Scatter over the berries and bake until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Rest, then serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Juice the lime up to 1 day ahead; blend just before drinking or the pineapple melts and the milk separates

steps.text: Blend the cold full cream milk, frozen pineapple, juice of the lime and blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue.
Pour into four glasses and drink straight away.

s.note: Panko crumbed prawns fried golden, with sweet chili sauce and lime
s.how: Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns. Dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 100g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges for squeezing.

s.note: Strawberries, blueberries and cherries with honey, mint and whipped mascarpone
s.how: Toss 250g strawberries, halved, 125g blueberries and 200g pitted cherries with 1 tbsp honey and torn mint. Whip 250g mascarpone with another spoon of honey until soft. Serve the fruit in a bowl with the mascarpone alongside.

m.note: Spatchcock chicken roasted over potatoes and carrots, glazed with honey
m.how: Spatchcock a 1.8kg chicken and lay over 800g potatoes and 4 carrots cut into chunks. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes. Brush with 3 tbsp honey warmed with 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme for the last 10 minutes. Rest and pull apart to share.

w.note: Mixed berry crumble with oats and hazelnuts, vanilla ice cream
w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Toss 750g frozen mixed berries with 80g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 120g plain flour until crumbly, then stir in 60g rolled oats, 50g chopped hazelnuts and 100g brown sugar. Scatter over the berries and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Cold milk blended with pineapple, lime and blue spirulina, no alcohol
d.how: Blend 800ml cold milk with 200g frozen pineapple, the juice of a lime and half a tsp blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue. Pour into four glasses and drink straight away, before the Ewoks get it.
